srt.name: SRT sheet 1
items: 1. He was appointed longer commander. The dal has often been having stones which was complained by the dining members. He...
2. He didn't do well in written test of ACC Commission. His friends advised him not to try for commission in future. He...
3. He was travelling in a train on reserved seat. A fellow passenger claimed to have the same seat on his reservation ticket. He...
4. On returning to his barrack from the firing range, he found that his friend had brought 20 rounds of 5.56 mm INSAS. He...
5. He was going to langar for taking his lunch when all of a sudden he observed that a helicopter crashed in the vicinity of his unit lines. He...
6. While on regiment football ground for game parade, he found a rifle disc lying in the ground. He...
7. He was called upon to organise a variety entertainment show in his unit for aid a Jawan's welfare. He...
8. The station HQ assured all facilities at the sight for the tree plantation but when he reached with ten Jawans, no arrangements were seen to have been made. He...
9. He was convoy commander on the way he learnt that there was a landslide ahead. He...
10. He was going on temporary duty in military vehicle when he suddenly developed fever. He...
11. He was performing the duties of MES NCO and MES staff demanded two bottles of liquor to attend his complaints. He...
12. He was to prepare for military promotion cadre exam but other friends wanted him to attend a private party. He...
13. While he was returning to his unit location in an auto rickshaw, a car hit his rickshaw from rear and he was thrown on the footpath. He...
14. After getting tired he wanted to sleep that night whereas he was asked to accompany a long range petrol with his sub Maj. He...
15. While carrying out his duties in Nagaland, he lost his route and he had supply of food available for 36 hrs. He...
16. His family members has fixed his marriage but his commanding officer detailed him for corp exercise. He...
17. He was duty NCO that night and he found that late night fire had broken out due to short-circuiting of electric connection. He...
18. He along with other JCO's wanted extra time for JCO club on Saturdays but his Sub Maj was against it. He...
19. He was detailed regularly on LRP but since he has brought his family in station he found it difficult to spare for his family. He...
20. While going on temp duty he had no relation time to get his warrant exchanged. He...
21. Since last few days he noticed that his subordinates shows very less interest in taking to him and few call him as an informer of Sub Maj. He...
22. On reaching home on 60 days annual leave, very next day he got a signal for his recall from leave due to military emergency. He...
23. On reaching late on parade his BHM humiliated him and also awarded him some physical punishment. He...
24. He wanted to carry extra rum bottle while going on leave but canteen officer refused to give him. He...
25. He was performing the duties of quarter master when his commanding officer asked him to give him 4 blankets and 4 net mosquito for his residence. He...
26. While on night duty he suddenly noticed that his colleague got fainted. He...
27. His mother wanted him to quit military service and look after his father's business but he wanted to continue. He...
28. His family was staying in peace station and he was asked to go to war front and send his family to his native town. He...
29. After reaching his promotion exam centre he found that he forget to take writing material. He...
30. He was posted at field area and his wife often call to him about the ill-treatment she was getting from his other family members. He...
31. While going to his regiment by scooter from family quarter, he found that a child met with an accident by his scooter. He...
32. While travelling by train he noticed that some civilian passengers started abusing the military persons in general. He...
33. He was posted at north-east and had some land work at his village. His village patwari wanted some bribe for doing that land work for his family. He...
34. He was posted at high altitude and recently married when came on last leave. After his marriage his in-laws were forcing him to leave the service. He...
35. While travelling by train he noticed that his suitcase is stolen and his identity card was also kept in the suitcase. He...
36. A documentary was planned on his regiment by ministry of defence and he was asked by his commanding officer to write an article about his regiment. He...
37. He was in army. He was engaged to a girl of his neighbouring village he has came on leave for marriage. After coming he found that there was a quarrel between two villages. He...
38. His sister's marriage date was on head but at the time his wife demanded some money because she wanted to open a beauty parlour. He...
39. His mother was serious, she wanted to meet him but the war had been declared. He...
40. He had been detailed to go with his on temp duty on the day while he was getting ready, his child got severely injured. He...
41. His sister's marriage and CME inspection were scheduled on the same day. He...
42. He got an information about a terrorist but his commander doesn't agree. He tried to convince him but all became useless. He...
43. He was standing on night duty in a post near LOC. He heard a sound of movement in front of him. He...
44. He was CO of a regiment one day he heard that one jawan of his regiment tried to shoot himself, but later he was well. He...
45. He was on leave when his wife committed a severe crime and his leave was about to get over. He...
46. He was serving in army and was married to a beautiful lady. After a short time of his marriage his wife demanded partition from his parents but he did not wanted to leave them. He...

47. He was proceeding on leave. At the same time of travelling by train he found that someone had picked up his suitcase. In that suitcase he had kept important documents and salaries of four months. He...
48. He was going to his home on leave with his friend. He found his friend committed theft in night. Nobody had watched this, only he caught him. He...
49. One day he had gone to station for reservation for proceeding on leave. There was no reservation charge on free warrant, but booking clerk was charging Rs. 50. He...
50. After running BPET, he found the magazine of his rifle has missed. He...
51. While returning to unit from leave he saw a man came to him and requested to sit on his berth. He gave him seat to the person and after few time that person offered some biscuits and tea. He...
52. He was going on leave but when he debarred the train and came out of station to check taxi, he found curfew in his city. He...
53. He was performing duty of BHM one day he saw two jawans were quarrelling each other and one had got injured badly. He...

54. While proceeding on leave a soldier doesn't got reservation. He wanted to enter into the military compartment. The train had started running but a soldier sitting inside doesn't opened the door and other compartment are packed. He...
55. His senior asked him to type a letter immediately but his company commander ordered for other details to him, which was not urgent. He...
56. He had gone on leave for urgent work only for 3 days CL when reached home he found that the work he had came for was expected to complete in 7 days. He...

57. He was on leave suddenly on the last day of is leave, his son got injured in a motor accident. He tried to inform his regiment for extension of leave but the phone was not working due to poor signals at his regiment location. He...

58. He was officer in-charge of five vehicles, which contained the food material for ten days and was going to field area, where the unit was deployed. Suddenly on the way vehicles were attacked by ten terrorists. He...
59. His unit was in counter insurgency operation and he got telegram that his father was serious but his co-refused to grant leave. He...

60. He was commanding officer of a regiment. Two persons of his regiment came to attend ACC examination but there is only one vacancy for your regiment both candidates were having same qualification and good. He...
